counter_evidence.text: Other services on the checkout path show no error status in the sampled failing traces: checkout->cart oteldemo.CartService/GetCart and oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart carry rpc.grpc.status_code 0, currency Currency/Convert carries otel.status_code OK and rpc.grpc.status_code 0, shipping oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote carries rpc.grpc.status_code 0 with http 200, product-catalog oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct carries rpc.grpc.status_code 0, and quote spans carry no status tag. This is a sampled view, not proof of their overall health.

fact.text: The alert expression's ratio is verified: evaluating sum(rate(checkout PlaceOrder server ERROR[5m])) / sum(rate(checkout PlaceOrder server total[5m])) over 03:19:04-03:39:04 gives 0 at every minute from 03:24:04 through 03:36:04, 0.653 at 03:37:04, 0.723 at 03:38:04 and 1.0 at 03:39:04, so the >0.5 threshold is currently exceeded at 100% error.

Failing checkout spans are operation oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, service checkout 2.0.2, span_kind SERVER, with status tags error=true, otel.status_code=ERROR, rpc.grpc.status_code=13 and otel.status_description 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold'; observed failing starts are 03:35:30, 03:36:28, 03:37:06, 03:38:01 and 03:38:49, while PlaceOrder spans with rpc.grpc.status_code=0 appear from 03:26:31 through 03:34:00.

The rejection is generated inside payment: payment's own span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (service payment 2.0.2) is ERROR with grpc.error_name 'Error', grpc.error_message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' and exception.stacktrace 'Error: Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13) at ... chargeServiceHandler (/usr/src/app/index.js:21:22)'; the same traces contain payment's child span 'charge' and a flagd call grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat with rpc.grpc.status_code=0.

Payment is currently rejecting all Charge calls: over a 2m window, rate of payment grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge STATUS_CODE_ERROR is 0.0167/s with STATUS_CODE_UNSET 0 at 03:38:04 and 03:39:04; over the 1h window 03:39:04 the same span_name has 20.3 ERROR and 61.0 UNSET spans, so the errors are concentrated at the end of the hour.

The identical payment failure occurred before the 03:26:24Z rollout: checkout PlaceOrder error spans at 02:44:59 and 02:46:11 carry the same 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' description and payment stacktrace at /usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13, and payment Charge's 5m STATUS_CODE_ERROR rate was non-zero at the 02:44:04 through 02:57:04 evaluations and exactly 0 at every evaluation from 02:58:04 through 03:36:04.

Payment Charge errors are recurrent, not new: with a 10m rate over 2026-11-16T15:39:04-2026-11-17T03:39:04, payment grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge STATUS_CODE_ERROR is non-zero in multiple buckets from 2026-11-16T22:49:04 (e.g. 0.0244/s at 22:49:04, 0.0333/s at 23:09:04, 0.0296/s at 01:39:04, 0.0278/s at 02:39:04) interleaved with zero buckets (23:29:04-23:49:04, 01:59:04-02:19:04, 03:09:04-03:29:04), and the checkout PlaceOrder ERROR series follows the same buckets.

The checkout rollout is corroborated by kube-state-metrics: ReplicaSet checkout-7797695bb6 has no sample at 03:24:04 and is present from 03:29:04, pod checkout-7797695bb6-86r6n has kube_pod_start_time 1794885984 (=2026-11-17T03:26:24Z), and the previous pod checkout-86bc54d9b7-zwcw8 is present through 03:24:04 and absent from 03:29:04.

Payment was not redeployed during the incident window: pod payment-6f7bc865d6-s8xt4 has kube_pod_start_time 1794808752 (2026-11-16T05:59:12Z), ReplicaSet payment-6f7bc865d6 (owner_kind Deployment, owner_name payment) is present at every sample from 02:39:04 to 03:39:04, and the only otel-demo pod with a start time after 1794885000 (~03:10) is checkout-7797695bb6-86r6n.

The failed checkouts propagate upward with their own error evidence: in the same traces frontend spans 'POST /api/checkout' and 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' are error=true with http.status_code 500 and exception '13 INTERNAL: failed to charge card: ... Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold', frontend-proxy 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' spans are error=true http 500, and load-generator 'POST' spans are error=true http 500; 5m error rates at 03:39:04 are frontend 0.0625/s, frontend-proxy 0.0417/s, load-generator 0.0167/s.

hypothesis.text: Hypothesis (payment-side config/flag toggle): because payment's pod has been up since 2026-11-16T05:59:12Z with no ReplicaSet change and the rejection recurs in multi-minute episodes, a runtime toggle in payment or its flagd-served configuration is making charge.js throw for every request. Consistent but not conclusive: flagd impression counts rose from 373 at 03:24:04 to 378 at 03:29:04, 417 at 03:34:04 and 459 at 03:39:04, but the only evaluation call visible in a failing trace (ResolveFloat from payment) returned grpc status 0 and the impression metric exposes no flag_key/variant labels here, so no specific flag can be named.

Hypothesis (invalid input supplied to payment): the token/card in the ChargeRequest is genuinely invalid and payment is rejecting it as designed, with the trigger in the request payload rather than in payment's code. This cannot be excluded because span data does not show the request payload; it is weakened by the fact that the same rejection predates the 03:26:24 checkout build and that the new checkout pod produced successful charges until 03:34:00.

report.summary: The alert is verified and its immediate mechanism is clear: checkout's PlaceOrder server spans fail because payment rejects the charge. The alert's own ratio expression was 0 at every 1-minute evaluation from 03:24:04 to 03:36:04, then 0.653 at 03:37:04, 0.723 at 03:38:04 and 1.0 at 03:39:04, i.e. currently 100% of PlaceOrder server spans end in error. Failing spans (service checkout 2.0.2, oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder) carry otel.status_code=ERROR and grpc status 13 with the description 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold'. The rejection is generated by payment: payment's own span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge is ERROR with grpc.error_message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' and a stacktrace at /usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13 (module.exports.charge), and at 03:38:04-03:39:04 payment's Charge spans are 100% error (404.0167/s, UNSET 0).
